gaps.desktop: In the loser, repetition shows up only as a tiny (~9px) grey repeat glyph stuck to the top-right of the 30px calendar circle in the Due date field. It crosses the field's top border and never says the rule: no weekday, no 'weekly', just '26 Aug'. The winner puts a ~14px repeat icon plus a 13px grey 'Every Monday' label right after a bold 'Mon, Aug 26'. Fix: drop the corner badge and add an inline repeat icon and rule text after the date (e.g. '26 Aug · Repeats every Monday') at body size in secondary grey.

why: The winner shows the due date with its weekday and the plain-language repeat rule side by side. The loser hides that the to-do repeats behind a clipped micro-badge and never states the rule.
